chain.title: Echo of a Nameless Kingdom
chain.desc: Set a Weakening Focus onto copper and string to replicate the gong of a kingdom buried under the sands - its distorted ring still stirs the desert ruins.

chain.title: Progeny of the Sands
chain.desc: The Parched are sun-scorched skeletons that haunt the desert and never burn in daylight; cutting them down is how you draw the buried kingdom's real mages out of hiding.

chain.title: Walk Like the Nameless
chain.desc: Sound the Ancient Gong in a desert to summon the Ruins Necromancer, the dead kingdom's reborn mage - it is your only source of Taboo Fragments.

chain.title: Forbidden Masonry
chain.desc: Claim a Taboo Fragment from the Ruins Necromancer; this shard of the nameless kingdom's stonework is the gate ingredient for the Catacombs Reliquary, Champion gear and the Starless Night.

chain.title: No More Burning Servants
chain.desc: Craft the Reliquary from a Taboo Fragment, Gale Fabric and steep planks - it grants your undead servants permanent immunity to sunlight, so your army finally marches at noon.

chain.title: Remedial Schooling
chain.desc: Mix a book with iron, Ectoplasm, a Magic Emerald, a savage tooth and powder snow. Using a grimoire on a Sorcerer Servant raises its rank by one - iron is the first rung of the ladder.

chain.title: Gilded Curriculum
chain.desc: Bind a Gold Grimoire with a Wind Core, redstone and gold to push sorcerers past iron rank - each grimoire tier caps how far a servant can be cultivated.

chain.title: The Green Degree
chain.desc: Ritual-craft the Emerald Grimoire from jade, a Magic Emerald and a Vexing Focus; it unlocks emerald-rank sorcery for your servants.

chain.title: Doctorate in Devilry
chain.desc: Ritual a diamond, budding amethyst, Resonance Crystal and a Frost Nova Focus into the Diamond Grimoire - the second-highest rank a Sorcerer Servant can reach.

chain.title: Laundering the Evidence
chain.desc: Ritual-transmute the Vizier's bloody Soul Ruby with Ectoplasm, a Forbidden Piece and a Mystic Core into a Soul Sapphire - the signature gem this addon's endgame rituals all ask for.

chain.title: Or Goety Boss
chain.desc: Forge the ultimate grimoire from a Soul Ruby, Forbidden Fragment, Shadow Essence and an enchanted golden apple, then enlighten a diamond-level sorcerer to ruby level - a servant that fights like a boss.

chain.title: Echoes Made Solid
chain.desc: Infuse an echo shard with a Hunger Core, Raging Matter and a Sonic Boom Focus; it also converts plain deepslate into reinforced deepslate, a lost ancient skill.

chain.title: A Warden of Your Own
chain.desc: Craft the Shadow Shrieker, set it on a charged Cursed Cage and feed it a Profound Echoing Shard to shape a loyal Warden Servant - hook up sculk sensors and it summons defenders automatically.

chain.title: Please Bring Your Own Diapers
chain.desc: Ritual a Soul Sapphire, Soul Jar, Mystic Core and diamond block into the Nether Reactor Core, then build the wither T with it at the center to raise a Wither Servant that obeys you.

chain.title: Chasing the Mirage
chain.desc: An eye of ender, iron and red sandstone make a Mirage Eye that tracks the Mirage - the badlands border fortress of the nameless kingdom, where its elite strength was buried.

chain.title: High and Dry
chain.desc: Follow the eye to the Mirage fortress in the badlands. Its garrison of Royal Guards and vanguards drops pale steel, and its vaults hold Dominance Scrolls.

chain.title: The King Below the Sand
chain.desc: Face the Nameless One, the forgotten king whose kingdom the desert swallowed. He is the only being that sheds Eschaton Platinum, the metal every piece of Champion gear demands.

chain.title: Eschaton Platinum
chain.desc: Gather Eschaton Platinum from the fallen king. With Mucilage, Glowing Embers and Dark Alloy it forges the Champion arsenal and the Heaven Rift Focus.

chain.title: Raiment of the Rearguard
chain.desc: Ritual Champion armor from Eschaton Platinum, Mucilage, Soul Sapphires and Dark Alloy - two pieces grant Shielding, the full set adds fall immunity, reach and a riptide dash.

chain.title: Divine Mandate
chain.desc: Loot a Dominance Scroll from the Mirage, the Ominous Castle or the Chaos Prison and study the badlands lords' secrets of rule - the research that opens the path to your own Monstrosity.

chain.title: Moo?
chain.desc: Craft a Prison Eye to track the Chaos Prison, where the powers of Overworld, Nether and End intertwine around a colossal caged war machine.

chain.title: Moo!
chain.desc: Break into the Chaos Prison and put down the out-of-control Mooshroom Monstrosity. Its remains yield the mycelial circuitry no ritual can create from scratch.

chain.title: Circuits of the Ancients
chain.desc: Duplicate the circuit stripped from the Prototype: a ritual over a Dark Alloy Ingot, mushroom blocks, an end crystal and a Soul Sapphire copies one circuit from another, keeping them renewable.

chain.title: Prototype
chain.desc: Ritual netherite, crying obsidian, end stone and mushroom blocks into Mushroom-Coated Alloy, the body material for building your own Mooshroom Monstrosity - a war machine that answers to you.

chain.title: The Mallet of Spores
chain.desc: Fuse a Mushroom-Coated Alloy Block, mycelial circuit and Soul Sapphire into the Mooshroom Mallet, a crushing weapon wrenched from the Prototype's design.

chain.title: Unyielding Edge
chain.desc: Ritual obsidian, crying obsidian, a Void Block and Dark Metal into the Obsidian Claymore - a greatsword worthy of upgrade into something far darker.

chain.title: Eye of Overwatch
chain.desc: Combine a Profound Echoing Shard, Philosopher's Stone, Stormlander and an end crystal into this relic - the last rare treasure the Starless Night ritual demands.

chain.title: The Starless Night
chain.desc: Upgrade the Obsidian Claymore with the Eye of Overwatch, Night Beacon, Blade of Ender and a Void Staff. The finished blade hurls void slashes, overkills into nearby foes, slots into staffs like a focus and drinks Soul Energy to repair itself.

notes: Goety endgame addon (Awakened Evil). Order sourced from the jar's own advancements (data/goetyawaken/advancements: root->walk_like_nameless, royal_research_completed->mushroom_monstrosity, chaos_prison->mushroom_monstrosity_kill->sporearm_race, upgrade_wizard, eternal_no_more, get_shadow_shrieker, high_and_dry) plus its Patchouli entries injected into goety's black_book (assets/goety/patchouli_books) and recipe JSON (data/goetyawaken/recipes, mostly goety:ritual type). Verified: all 28 chain + 34 collection item ids against the 215 lang item/block stems; kill targets parched, parched_necromancer, nameless_one, hostile_mushroom_monstrosity in entity lang; structure mirage in worldgen/structure (23 structures total). Taboo Fragment source = Ruins Necromancer per walk_like_nameless advancement (icon+desc). royal_scroll (Dominance Scroll) confirmed in chests/chaos_prison, mirage, ominous_castle loot. Eye trio tooltips confirm structure tracking (ominous_eye/prison_eye/mirage_eye). Requires mid-to-late Goety (magic emeralds, rituals, dark ingots) throughout - gate this mod's quests behind the goety chain. Extra verified bosses if wanted: kill:goetyawaken:wraith_necromancer (Glacial Ghost House, drops music disc + spirit fabric), kill:goetyawaken:arch_illusioner (drops delusive_fragment for the Illusion Robe), structure:goetyawaken:chaos_prison, structure:goetyawaken:ominous_castle.
